resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to reset your password. Click the button below to choose a new one.

verifyEmail.body: Hi {name}, thanks for signing up. Confirm your email address to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.footer: If you did not create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

changeEmailConfirmation.subject: Confirm your new email address
changeEmailConfirmation.preview: Confirm your email change for SaaSy Land
changeEmailConfirmation.heading: Confirm email change
changeEmailConfirmation.body: Hi {name}, we received a request to change your email address to {newEmail}. Click the button below to confirm this change.
changeEmailConfirmation.footer: If you did not request this change, you can safely ignore this email.
